title: Splitting the Storm
summary: Escort Lila Trulan to the entrance and survive the captors waiting there.
overview: Escort Lila Trulan to the entrance and survive the captors waiting there.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Use stop to park Lila safely while clearing the path, and prepare for the final two adds.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: One player claims the escort and can direct Lila with 'follow' and 'stop'.
Other players cannot take over while that owner is still in the zone.
Reaching the entrance area summons two captors and advances the escort objective.

notes: Approval E370. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
